name: MJX MPC Twister
author: Michał Jasikowski
summary: MPC Live III on MPC OS 3.10.1.12 only. Turn your Twister knobs to reach all 16 Q-Links without changing banks. Press a knob to jump to a track or open a shortcut. The lights follow your settings and track selection. Installation needs root access, writes to internal storage, and restarts the MPC app.
